headline: Cal State LA and Cal State San Bernardino play on alone
dek: Cal State LA and Cal State San Bernardino both won their latest matches, and are the only programmes in the conference with a match left to play. Cal State LA are twenty matches without a defeat, with six goals conceded; the last side to beat Cal State San Bernardino was Cal State LA.
